decision: Adopt only matching author/reopen/inspect/render operations; no actual artifact result, full OpenAPI certification or real-world geographic accuracy is inferred.

operations.yaml_openapi_author_and_schema_validatio: Known OpenAPI3 YAML/text creation, exact YAML roundtrip, field/local-reference inspection and simple reusable JSON body validation with wrong-type/missing-field/malformed-YAML negative controls; no specialized full OpenAPI validator was executed.
operations.geospatial_map_author: Known coordinates/roads to one-page PDF, exact known label/page inspection, real native render and independent numerical verification of all pin centers and directional ordering.

limits: Known generic fixtures establish bounded shared operation availability, not actual task success or original criterion outcomes.
OpenAPI design validity and whole-document semantic conformance still require actual-artifact inspection. No robot/mission design was generated.
Actual addresses, coordinates, real basemap/source selection and prompt/rubric conflicts remain distinct source/content obligations. No real listings or geocoding were used.
Controller owns adoption and final acceptance; no runtime/dependency or tracked mapping changes occurred during these workflows.
source_classification_clarifications: Dedicated OpenAPI validator, deployed endpoint/cloud services and 200GB transfers are not original output prerequisites.
Named CRS transformation, GIS package or geocoding service is not specified by the location-spread map request.
Map is a prompt-level obligation; no map-specific rubric item is invented. Existing PDF/style items remain unchanged in the proposed mapping.
